reviews.text: Cannot recommend this clinic enough! Having moved to Youghal last year, I was very sad to be moving away from our previous vet clinic in Galway. However, finding Blue Coast for my cat has been a blessing! Over various visits the team have been so professional, compassionate and overall just brilliant with my cat. From routine visits to a small surgery, every visit has left me at ease with the care my cat has received.

A lovely friendly place to bring your pets.
From the lady on reception to Cassandra the vet.
My puppy was in for his vaccine and had a great experience.

I have been here with all different types of animals,  dogs, rabbits and hens and always recieve great care. What I like about blue coast is they take the time to examine the animal and you aren't rushed out the door. Johanna and Cassandra are great vets and all the staff are friendly
Took my Cotonoodle and my niece’s King Charles to the clinic on 15th. I cannot speak highly enough of Vet Roh. Such a soft, kind and gentle man. Thank you Roh from Juno and Lily
Thanks so much vet Roh for the care and kindness shown when treating our very nervous dog. Spotless treatment room and waiting area. Highly recommend.

I posted this comment three years ago.
Now I want to re affirm my faith in this wonderful Vet. Johanna is knowledgable & professional, yet kind & compassionate with all animals.  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Thank you all at Blue Coast Vet Clinic, Youghal

Johanna & team run a very professional and friendly veterinarian practice. Attending there with both cat & dog over several years. Great care.
I have two senior chihuahuas, and I wish I discovered this clinic when they were younger. Johanna is outstanding!!! So kind, gentle, and thorough with her examinations.
The best vet around! They are happy to give their time to you and answer any questions and you don’t feel rushed. They are very knowledgeable and caring. I highly recommend them and my dog does too!
Excellent vets, very caring and great with cats
Friendly and professional. Can only highly recommend
